question: By what contemplative procedure should the self be flooded from the pericarp upward?
premises: The self is to be placed in the pericarp
The upper wheel serves as the instrument
Flooding is prescribed as the action
inference: After placing the self in the pericarp, one should flood it by means of the upper wheel
plain_english: Having placed the self in the pericarp, one should flood it by means of the upper wheel.
